facts.value: Uses arg0[1] & 0x80100480 as its cache key; all 16 possible masked combinations have switch cases. Equality returns before all writes. On a miss, four untextured bit-0x80 cases clear that bit in both input and cache before fallthrough; other modes retain it. The static cache begins at zero, so a first zero-mode call skips programming unless invalidated. Cache validity depends on external GX state ownership; this routine does not reinstall common operations on ordinary paths.

facts.value: Unconditionally configures stages 0..2 order, add/zero-bias/scale1/clamped operations writing PREV, and swap0 selectors. Does not set stage counts, texgen counts, color/alpha inputs, register values or cache. Calling it does not invalidate prevTev[0], so the caller must maintain cache coherence when resetting GX state.
